Parallax scrolling background package for jEngine — multi-layer depth-based scrolling.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Built-in: linked into the stock runtime and editor viewport |
| Source | `packages/jengine-parallax` |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Entry point | `jengine_parallax::ParallaxPackage` |
| Script namespace | `Parallax` |

## Using it

The stock runtime, web build and editor viewport are compiled with this package, so there is
nothing to link. A project that has a `settings.enabled_packages` list must name it there, since
that list is an allow-list once it exists; a project without the key gets every built-in.

```json
{ "settings": { "enabled_packages": ["jengine-parallax"] } }
```

A scene that uses its components must be a **v2** scene (`"version": 2`): a v1 scene has no field
for a package component and keeps it as inert custom data.

A script can check that the package is linked with `if Parallax == nil then return end`.

## Components

| Scene key | Rust type | |
|---|---|---|
| `parallax_layer` | `ParallaxLayer` | package only: needs a v2 scene |

## Script commands

Commands run in every runtime and return nothing; a package publishes what scripts read onto
components (see the notes below). The flat name also works.

| Call | Flat name |
|---|---|
| `Parallax.set(e, x, y)` | `parallax_set` |
| `Parallax.set_auto_scroll(e, x, y)` | `parallax_set_auto_scroll` |

## Notes

*From `packages/jengine-parallax/README.md`.*

Parallax scrolling: background layers that move slower than the camera and
foreground layers that move faster, so a flat scene reads as deep.

This is a **built-in** package: the native runtime, the web runtime and the
editor viewport are compiled with it. Unlike physics, audio and particles it
has no hard-coded path in any runtime - its `parallax_scroll` system runs
only because each host runs package systems, which is what made it the
package that proved the package system works (scene 59 in the Engine Test
Lab).

### What it registers

| Component | Is |
|---|---|
| `parallax_layer` | `scroll_factor_x` / `_y` (0 stays put on screen, 1 moves with the world, above 1 is foreground), `repeat_x` / `_y` with `repeat_width` / `_height` to wrap a strip, `offset_x` / `_y`, `auto_scroll_x` / `_y` in units per second, and `z_order_override`. |

`parallax_layer` is a **package** component: a scene that uses it must be a
v2 scene (`"version": 2`).

The layer's transform is rewritten every frame at `PreRender` from the active
camera, so set the layer up through the component, not by moving it.

### From scripts

| Call | Does |
|---|---|
| `Parallax.set(e, x, y)` | Set the scroll factors. |
| `Parallax.set_auto_scroll(e, x, y)` | Set the auto-scroll speed. |

Both work in every runtime. The older flat globals `set_parallax` and
`set_parallax_auto_scroll` are installed by the native runtime only (they are
`ScriptApiRegistry` handlers, which the editor and web do not run) - use the
`Parallax` namespace.

See the [Parallax guide](/guides/parallax/).
